text:
sofia: follow-up on 'soft transfer' idea 9: we need clear lifecycle boundaries for moving active streaming sessions between proxies without client reconnects.
raj: quick sketch? main concerns: ordering, dupes, kv-cache.
sofia: flow: client->A. decide to rebalance. A marks TRANSFERRING, requests transfer ticket from control plane. control plane issues X-Transfer-Token scoped to B. A mirrors recent upstream outputs + small KV-delta to B over encrypted control tunnel for warmup. B opens upstream resume. during grace_ms both A and B may produce overlap. after B ready, control plane flips route atomically; A tombstones session after tombstone_ttl.
mike: dedupe via (session_uuid, chunk_seq) + checksum; maintain tombstone map for recent seqs. billing: small overlap doubles token count; surface transfer_overlap_tokens metric and keep grace_ms small (default 150ms).
jen: KV-prime worries: deltas can be large; limit to sliding window (kv_prime_window) and make opt-in per-tenant.
raj: retries: include origin_proxy_id in retry token and sign it; new proxy rejects chunk_seq <= max_acked.
sofia: sample config:
soft_transfer:
  grace_ms: 150
  tombstone_ttl_ms: 5000
  kv_prime_enabled: true
  kv_prime_window: 1000
  transfer_header: "X-Transfer-Token"
  seq_sig_algo: rsa-sha256
raj: observability: attach transfer_id to spans; metrics: transfer_overlap_tokens, transfer_latency_ms, kv_prime_size_bytes.
jen: rollout plan: 1) read-only mirror to collect overlap data, 2) flips for low-traffic tenants, 3) widen. alerts: duplicate_rate>0.5% or median_transfer_latency>120ms.
ops-bot: canary toggled (ff/soft-transfer/us-west-2).
sofia: action items: mike perf harness (4d), raj token proto (3d), jen dashboards (2d), sofia control-plane API (5d). keep transfers intra-tenant/region for now.
mike: kv-prime must be encrypted with tenant KMS keys.
jen: i'll PR dashboards. :white_check_mark:
